description: This file contains abstract test class for verifying multiple grain directory implementations in an Orleans-based distributed system. It sets up testing infrastructure, defines test methods for communication and activation behaviors, and includes helper methods for obtaining specific grains based on silo placement.

classes.name: MultipleGrainDirectoriesTests
classes.description: Abstract class for testing multiple grain directory implementations, managing test cluster configuration, and providing methods to interact with specific grain instances based on silo placement.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Overrides base method to configure initial number of silos in the test cluster.

methods.name: PingGrain
methods.description: Test method that verifies interaction between grains on primary and secondary silos, including ping operations and silo shutdown behavior.

methods.name: GetGrainOnPrimary
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a grain instantiated on the primary silo based on runtime instance ID.

methods.name: GetGrainOnSecondary
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a grain instantiated on the secondary silo based on runtime instance ID.
